video_title: Perk Wants Cooper Flagg Taking the Last Shot Over Kyrie Irving

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins criticizes the final play call for the Mavericks
quotes.excerpt: I thought it was a rookie mistake last night for the last shot of the game.
quotes.quote: I thought it was a rookie mistake last night for the last shot of the game. I believe that Kyrie, one of the greatest, most skilled players that this game has ever seen, I get that. He's hit big shots. Obviously, you all saw it firsthand. Last night to me, that last shot should have gone to Cooper Flagg. Win, lose, or draw, if you're trying to establish a relationship and get the synergy that you need with your franchise guy, because we don't know how long Kyrie is going to be there. He may be gone at the trade deadline.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson and Kendrick Perkins debate the final play call
quotes.excerpt: I think he's talking about waiting till the last second. Kyrie waited a little long.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: I think he's talking about waiting till the last second. Kyrie waited a little long.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: No, he said drop the play for Cooper Flagg.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: You have to give that ball to Kyrie. You have to give that ball to Kyrie.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins argues Kyrie Irving had three bad possessions
quotes.excerpt: Kyrie had three straight bad possessions. First of all, they wasted too much time on the clock.
quotes.quote: Kyrie had three straight bad possessions. First of all, they wasted too much time on the clock because they should have got another possession out of there. 24 seconds shouldn't have been, that's more to extend the game. That's number one. Number two, I'm looking at coach Dusty May and I'm saying the person that you're about to build with for the next probably two or three years is not going to be Kyrie Irving. The person that you're building with is going to be Cooper Flagg. So how do you establish the trust in that relationship? You establish by saying, 'Motherfucker, I'm going to you.'

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson defends the decision to give Kyrie the ball
quotes.excerpt: The only thing you would have possibly wanted is a sooner shot. That is Kyrie Irving right there.
quotes.quote: The only thing you would have possibly wanted is a sooner shot. That is Kyrie Irving right there. Ray Allen with LeBron James and Dwyane Wade and Chris Bosh, they would go draw up plays for him. Even though it's LeBron James and the three-time MVP, they would draw up plays. Dwyane Wade, champion, Finals MVP, they would draw up a play. In that moment, if you have Kyrie Irving on your team and he has 25, 28, 30, even if he had a bad game, that's Kyrie Irving. He's not having a 15-point game night, he's having a 30-ball. That ball goes to Kyrie in my playbook 100 times out of 100.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins critiques the play design for young players
quotes.excerpt: LeBron James as a first, second, third-year player, the play was being drawn up for him.
quotes.quote: LeBron James as a first, second, third-year player, the play was being drawn up for him. Dwyane Wade, the play was even with Shaq, the play was even with Shaq. All I'm saying is that if I'm a coach, I get how great of a player Kyrie is, I understand that. But at least do this. At least, okay, fuck drawing up a play for Kyrie, fuck drawing up a play for Cooper. At least do a two-man action, where that way they can decide. At least do some type of, with not putting Cooper in the corner.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson explains why he would trust Kyrie over anyone
quotes.excerpt: If there was a 19-year-old LeBron, the chosen one, you put that 35-year-old Kyrie next to 19-year-old Bron, that ball is going to Kyrie Irving.
quotes.quote: If there was a 19-year-old LeBron, the chosen one, you put that 35-year-old Kyrie next to 19-year-old Bron, that ball is going to Kyrie Irving. And it should. The only thing that we could say from a legitimate standpoint is they should have gotten two shots. They should have gotten two shots. That's the only thing that I think the basketball community can agree on. We can all have our different opinions on who should have got the shot. Me, I'm giving that ball to Kyrie.
